decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete message-89 MODIFY recording the approved higher-power PWM controllers, 50A adapter, and component compatibility; no additional or corrected Event is needed.
The candidate already has a complete message-89 MODIFY recording the 50A supply, higher-power PWM controllers, and reserve-capacity requirement.
Approval of the BOM and corresponding wiring-plan components does not itself establish a new CAD or physical-layout constraint beyond the candidate's existing layout deliverable.
The electrical component selections do not change the existing splash-control behavior or mitigation requirements.
Selecting a 50A AC/DC adapter does not replace or modify the approved standard 120V wall-outlet power source.
The BOM approval does not change the existing strategy of using off-the-shelf electrical components for the prototype.
Higher-power PWM controllers support implementation but do not change the approved 0-to-3000 RPM adjustment range or intended speed modes.
The wiring-plan power components do not change the solenoid dispensing mechanism, sequence, flow behavior, or no-drip requirement.
The approved adapter and motor controllers do not alter the requirement to isolate electrical components from liquid leakage.
Electrical reserve capacity is already represented by the load-capacity Requirement and does not change the motors' prolonged-use or maximum-speed duty constraints.
The approved electrical components do not change bowl removal, swapping, or clearance behavior.
The wiring-plan component selections do not change bowl capacity, depth, geometry, or enclosure-size constraints.
